tour_project_desc: Everything you record is saved to a project. Tap here and choose one to begin.
tour_add_desc: Tap the plus button to open the list of things you can record.
tour_single_tree_desc: Use this to record one tree on its own. You will mark where it stands, then say what it is.
tour_map_tap_desc: Tap the map on the spot where the tree stands. Move and zoom the map first if you need to place it exactly.
tour_confirm_location_desc: Happy with the pin? Continue. If the GPS signal is weak you will be asked whether to try again.
tour_species_desc: Choose the species from the list. Search by name, or pick one of your favourites.
tour_review_species_desc: Make sure the species is right, then continue to the review screen.
tour_save_desc: Read it over, then save. It stays on this device until it syncs, so you can finish this offline.
tour_start_alert_message: This walks you through recording a single tree on the real screens. Anything you record is real, so use a test project if you are only practising.
species_tour_start_alert_message: This walks you through your species list on the real screens. You will add a species to your list and open one to edit it, so the changes are real.
species_tour_search_desc: Tap here to search every species by name.
species_tour_type_desc: Start typing a scientific or common name. Results appear as you type.
species_tour_favourite_desc: Tap the heart to add this species to your list. Tap it again to take it off.
species_tour_back_desc: Done searching? Go back to see the species you saved.
species_tour_filter_desc: Switch this off to see the species you saved. Only those can be edited or removed.
species_tour_remove_desc: The heart on a card removes that species from your list. Nothing is removed right now.
species_tour_open_desc: Tap a card to open it. That is where you change what it looks like and what it is called.
species_tour_photo_desc: Take or pick a photo, so the species is easy to spot in the field.
species_tour_details_desc: Give it a local name and notes. Changes save as you type.
tours_hint: Pick a walkthrough. Each one runs on the real screens, so anything you record or change is real.
tour_single_tree_summary: Mark where a tree stands, say what it is, and save it.
tour_species_summary: Add a species to your list, then change its name or photo.
tour_plot_summary: Set its shape and size, then place it on the map.
plot_tour_start_alert_message: This walks you through creating a monitoring plot on the real screens. The plot you make is real, so use a test project if you are only practising.
plot_tour_needs_project: Join or create a project first. A plot has to belong to one.
plot_tour_add_desc: Tap the plus button to open the list of things you can record.
plot_tour_option_desc: A plot is a fixed patch of ground you come back to and measure again over time.
plot_tour_settings_desc: Pick the project this plot belongs to, then its shape and type. Control plots are the ones you did not plant.
plot_tour_continue_desc: Happy with those? Continue to name the plot and give its size.
plot_tour_form_desc: Give the plot a name you will recognise in the field, then its size in metres. A photo helps you find it again.
plot_tour_create_desc: Tap Create. Next you will place the plot on the map.
plot_tour_center_desc: Stand at the middle of the plot. Move the map so the crosshair sits on that spot, then tap Select Center.
plot_tour_confirm_desc: The plot is drawn at the size you gave. Reset to move it, or Continue to save.
plot_tour_tabs_desc: Plants lists what grows here, Ecosystem holds your observations, and Map shows the plot. You are on Plants.
plot_tour_plants_desc: Tap here to record each plant: its species, size, and where it stands inside the plot. That is the tour done.
tour_site_summary: Walk the boundary on the map and save it to a project.
site_tour_start_alert_message: This walks you through creating a site on the real screens. The site is saved to your project on the server, so use a test project if you are only practising.
site_tour_needs_project: Join or create a project first. A site has to belong to one.
site_tour_add_desc: Tap the plus button to open the list of things you can record.
site_tour_option_desc: A site is an area inside a project. You record interventions against it later.
site_tour_details_desc: Pick the project this site belongs to, then give the site a name you will recognise in the field.
site_tour_status_desc: Say where the site is up to: planting, planted, barren, or reforestation. You can change it later on the web.
site_tour_draw_desc: Tap here to open the map and mark the edge of the site.
site_tour_mark_desc: Stand at a corner, move the map so the crosshair is on it, and tap to mark it. Mark at least three. Previous Point undoes the last one.
site_tour_complete_desc: Continue adds another corner. Complete joins the last corner back to the first and takes you back to the form.
site_tour_save_desc: Check the shape above, then create the site. This one needs a connection, as the site is saved to your project on the server.
